text: MsgRail 是 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面插件，在对话输入框下方添加水平消息索引轨道。它按顺序为当前会话中用户发送的消息显示刻度，并通过会话事件窗口分页读取历史、订阅新消息。悬停刻度可查看消息内容和相对时间，点击可将聊天记录滚动到对应的大致位置；界面文案支持中文和英文，适合需要回看自己发言的用户。无需额外配置密钥或外部服务。

MsgRail adds a message index below the composer in DeepSeek Harness. It displays ticks for your messages, reads session history, and subscribes to new events. Hover to preview message text and time, or click to scroll the transcript to an approximate position. It has Chinese and English labels.
我想快速浏览当前聊天里自己发过的消息，最好能看到每条消息在历史中的位置。
有没有办法悬停在消息标记上就预览内容和发送时间？
我想从消息导航条点一下，跳到聊天记录中大概对应的地方。
MsgRail 的会话消息索引：切换会话时读取历史事件并逐页扩展消息窗口，同时订阅后续更新，为用户发送的消息生成按顺序排列的刻度。
MsgRail 的预览与跳转：悬停或聚焦消息刻度时显示消息文本和相对时间；点击刻度后按消息在索引中的序号滚动聊天记录。

dsh-msgrail README · MsgRail（dsh-msgrail）— v2.0.0 for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x：> **MsgRail** is a compact **full-history message rail** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): one thin tick per message **you** sent in the current conversation, docked in the ambient strip below the composer. Hover a tick to preview the message, click to jump into that part of the transcript. The rail indexes the whole history — messages the chat has not loaded yet included.
>
> **MsgRail（消息轨道）**——DeepSeek Harness 的全量消息轨道插件：在当前会话的输入框下方，为你发送的每条消息显示一根细刻度；悬停预览、点击跳转；插件自行分页加载完整历史，聊天窗口还没加载的旧消息也会出现在索引里。
>
> 中文文档见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

dsh-msgrail README · Status: 2.0.0 (DSH 0.2.x)：| | |
|---|---|
| Plugin | `dsh-msgrail` 2.0.0 |
| Harness | DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (Desktop or `dsh web`) |

dsh-msgrail README · What changed from 1.x：1.x patched `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` to add a `shell.history` grid column. DSH 0.2 builds every client package as a dynamic bundle, so that patch no longer applies. Version 2 registers through the documented slot API instead:

dsh-msgrail README · What changed from 1.x：| 1.x | 2.0.0 |
|---|---|
| `shell.history` slot added by a layout patch | `conversation.composer.dock` (additive, session-scoped) |
| Vertical rail left of the chat | Horizontal tick strip below the composer |
| Current session guessed from `sessions.current` | `sessionId` supplied by the session-scoped slot |
| `session.history({beforeSeq})` RPC + snapshot fallback | `ctx.sessions.binding(id).eventSource` + `session.loadOlder()` |
| Click used `[data-chat-anchor-key]` | Proportional jump inside `[data-conversation-scroll]` |
| Imported `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` | No primitives import; local SVG/CSS only |

dsh-msgrail README · What changed from 1.x：DSH 0.2 also ships its own turn rail on the right of the transcript. MsgRail is deliberately different: it indexes **user messages across the full history**, not turns in the loaded window.

---

dsh-msgrail README · What it does：- **Full-history index.** On session switch the rail pages the entire durable log in the background (`loadOlder()`), bounded so a pathological log cannot stall the UI, then keeps the tail live through the session event subscription.
- **Hover preview.** Role, relative time and up to six lines of the message, clamped inside the viewport.
- **Click to jump.** Scrolls the transcript toward the message's position in the history. Jumping is *approximate*: DSH 0.2 removed the stable per-message DOM anchors, so the rail maps the tick's ordinal onto the transcript scroll range.
- **Live and localized.** New messages appear as the session grows; UI copy is registered through `ctx.locale` (zh + en).
- **Theme-native.** Uses `--dsw-alias-*` tokens only.

dsh-msgrail README · 1. Plugin Manager (Desktop)：The package is a bundle (`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`). Point the Plugin Manager's “install from folder” at this directory and enable `dsh-msgrail`.

dsh-msgrail README · 2. CLI：```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-msgrail
```

dsh-msgrail README · 3. Profile patch (manual)：Install/link the package into the profile's `node_modules`, then add to `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: msgrail
      name: 'dsh-msgrail'
```

Reload the page after installation. Nothing else is patched.

dsh-msgrail README · Verify：1. Open a conversation with at least one message from you.
2. A thin strip with one tick per message appears directly below the composer; the count is shown at the right.
3. Hover a tick → preview card; click a tick → transcript scrolls.
4. Switch sessions → the strip rebuilds for the new session.
5. Settings → General → Locale switch (zh/en) updates the preview labels.

dsh-msgrail README · Limitations：- **Approximate jumps.** Exact per-message scrolling needs a stable anchor that the 0.2 conversation no longer exposes to plugins.
- **Bounded paging.** The initial walk stops after 80 `loadOlder()` pages; a session longer than that keeps the newest ~80 pages indexed.
- **Client-only.** No agent tools, no host routes, no configuration.
dsh-msgrail README · Uninstall：Remove the `msgrail` row (Plugin Manager → disable, or delete the `insert` block) and reload.

dsh-msgrail README · Repository layout：```
lib/index.js    Host half: minimal Loader row (client discovery needs it)
lib/client.js   Browser bundle: rail component, styles, locale, data path
package.json    dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client declaration
cordis.patch.yml

dsh-msgrail README · Development：The browser half is plain ES5-compatible JavaScript using
`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`. It requires only `react` and the
session/locale/slot services listed in `inject`. Syntax check with:

```bash
node --check lib/client.js
```
